rows.label: tlk4750016502_msg0001
rows.name:
Well then... Let me tell you
a story from long ago.

rows.label: tlk4750016502_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm sure you know of the stone
monument at the village outskirts,
our resident Village Guardian?

rows.label: tlk4750016502_msg0004
rows.name:
Thanks to Adel-sama's protection,
this village has avoided conflict
and lived in peace.

rows.label: tlk4750016502_msg0005
rows.name:
The Luxurian royal family is said
to descend from Adel-sama, but
between us, it isn't direct...

rows.label: tlk4750016502_msg0006
rows.name:
What?! You knew that already?
You know more than I do, and
I'm the village chief...
